# hestiacp_web_domain_ftp (Resource)

Manages an FTP account for a HestiaCP web domain.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Web domain to attach FTP to.
- `ftp_password` (String, Sensitive) FTP password.
- `ftp_user` (String) FTP username.

### Optional

- `ftp_path` (String) FTP chroot path. Defaults to the domain's document root.
- `user` (String) HestiaCP username. Defaults to the provider `username`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
